rule.note: HIGH when |today − median(last ≤7 prior heat-history prices)| / median ≥ 50%. SOFT at ≥40% and <50%. Review label: TCGplayer flat while the eBay median jumped → likely bad listing. Both moved the same way → possible real move. Opposite moves, a missing series, or a held id → review. Only possible real move is a Flagged read. Packs skipped. Do not invent prices.
